verdict.rationale: The API/SDK evidence shows per-domain operations (check, create, renew, lock) that could be scripted across many domains, and CheckWithContext explicitly supports checking multiple domains at once, but there is no direct evidence of a native bulk UI for search, registration, renewal, nameserver changes, or transfers across a portfolio. Missing for 10: dashboard bulk-select renewal/nameserver/transfer tools, bulk registration workflow, and any first-party or community confirmation these bulk actions work at scale in the actual product UI.
